note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 Honda Civic Factory Service Manual (96-00), First Edition 8/99. It holds the 6th generation Civic hatchback as a wheeled civilian-car lead. The manual publishes the identity, overall dimensions, wheelbase, track, ground clearance and per-trim gross vehicle weight ratings. It publishes no curb weight, no operating weight, no payload, no engine rated power, no engine torque and no tyre size or pressure, so the entry is not runtime-ready.
